quests.title: Fever Dreams
quests.objective: Bring 2 Fever to the Towner outside the Crimson Crest alchemy shop.
quests.description:
You've got the hang of the alchemist's table, I see.
I've caught the island chill and nothing warms me like a good dose of Fever. Mahn-Mann Mushrooms and Heartberries, two of each per bottle.
Bring me two bottles and I'll make it worth your while.
quests.descriptionForEnder: Ahh, that's the stuff! Here, take this for your trouble, and a bottle of my own Heartberry Liquor.
